comment: What Aiko does with one of its own files after it tried to read it: settings.json, environments.json, terminal.json, persona.json. A missing or empty file reads as the defaults. A file that is not a JSON object is set aside as .bad, and the defaults are used. A file that exists but could not be read (busy, no rights) also gives the defaults for now, but nothing may be written over it until it is read again: the next save would put the defaults in place of the person's choices. text null means the read failed. On the Mac, bytes that are not UTF-8 are read with replacement characters and so are not a JSON object.
